gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.561715 28.411566)',4326)::geography, 4500)
  AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

```sql
WITH target_poi AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.561715 28.411566)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 4500) AS geom
  FROM target_poi
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(r.rast, ST_Transform(buffered_area.geom, 4326)::geometry, TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM buffered_area, public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(buffered_area.geom, 4326)::geometry, r.rast)
),
elevation_check AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_rast, 1)).*
  FROM raster_clip
),
valid_cells AS (
  SELECT 
    geom
  FROM elevation_check
  WHERE val >= 40
),
poi_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM target_poi), 4500)
    AND p.addr_state = 'FL'
    AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
),
final_restaurants AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.poi_name,
    pc.geometry
  FROM poi_candidates pc
  WHERE ST_Intersects(pc.geometry::geometry, (SELECT geom FROM valid_cells))
)
SELECT 
  poi_name
FROM final_restaurants;
```
